# displaymotion

> Java library for Paper 26.3 plugins. Animates vanilla item, block and text displays with packets through PacketEvents. No resource pack, no real entities, no main thread work.

Use these facts when you write code with this library:

- Entry point: `DisplayMotion motion = DisplayMotion.create(plugin);` once in `onEnable`, on the main thread.
- The plugin needs `depend: [packetevents]` in plugin.yml. Do not shade PacketEvents.
- Gradle: `implementation("com.github.Jan1k1.displaymotion:displaymotion-packetevents:main-SNAPSHOT")` from `https://jitpack.io`, plus `compileOnly` Paper API and `com.github.retrooper:packetevents-spigot`.
- Spawn: `motion.item(location, itemStack)`, `motion.block(location, blockData)`, `motion.text(location, component)`, or `motion.model(location).block(name, blockData, pose[, parent]).item(...).text(...).spawn()`.
- Every spawn returns a `MotionDisplay`. Its methods return the same object, so chain them. They are safe from any thread.
- Animate: `display.play(animation)`, `display.play(animation, onEnd)`, `display.play("part", animation)`, `display.stop()`.
- Animations: `Animations.popIn(ticks)`, `popOut(ticks)`, `spin(ticksPerTurn)`, `turn(pitch, yaw, roll, ticks)`, `bob(height, ticks)`, `slide(x, y, z, ticks, ease)`, `hold(ticks)`. Combine with `a.then(b)`, `a.with(b)`, `a.loop()`. Custom: `Animation.keyframes().at(tick, pose, ease).build()`.
- Pose: `Pose.IDENTITY.withOffset(x, y, z).withRotation(pitch, yaw, roll).withScale(s)`. Degrees. Rotation order yaw, pitch, roll.
- Ease: `Ease.LINEAR`, `Ease.IN`, `Ease.OUT`, `Ease.IN_OUT`.
- Looks use Bukkit types: `display.glow(Color)`, `display.brightness(new Display.Brightness(block, sky))`, `display.billboard(Display.Billboard.CENTER)`, `display.text(Component)`. Each also takes a part name first.
- Move: `display.teleport(location)` or `display.teleport(location, glideTicks)` with 0 to 59 ticks.
- Visibility: `display.hide(player)`, `display.show(player)`, `display.visibleByDefault(false)`, `display.viewRange(blocks)` (default 48).
- Remove: `display.remove()`. `motion.close()` removes all, and happens by itself on plugin disable.
- Keep animations in `static final` fields. Call `play` in the same tick as spawning.
- Model rules: parent before child. Offset and rotation pass to children, a part's scale does not. Blocks pivot at their center.
- Limits: animations at most 6000 ticks, spin at least 6 ticks per turn, models at most 256 parts, text at most 32000 JSON characters.
